03 / Fintech & finance

AltisCassa — An integrated finance and cash management platform

Multi-currency cash management, counterparty debts and 11+ financial reports.

Scope
Fintech & finance
  • 11+

01 / Overview

AltisCassa is an all-in-one system that centralises a business’s cash operations, counterparty obligations, project budgets and corporate reporting, handling multi-currency transactions, invoice flows and financial reports in real time.

02 / The problem

Cash, debts and project budgets were kept in separate Excel files. Month-end profit and loss meant merging them by hand, and nobody had a clear real-time balance per currency.

03 / Our approach

Clean Architecture with separate domain, application, infrastructure and API layers. Every operation leaves an audit trail, and deletions are soft-only, so financial data is never lost for good.

04 / The result

Profit and loss, cash flow, turnover, VAT and ageing reports are generated instantly, and a Ctrl+K command palette gives one-step access to the advanced features.

05 / Key features

What it does.

  • 01

    Centralised cash management

    Cash across multiple currencies in one place.

  • 02

    Counterparties and debts

    Debt management with per-currency analytics.

  • 03

    Project finance

    Budget versus actual spending and profitability analysis.

  • 04

    Invoice workflow with VAT

    From draft to payment, including printing.

  • 05

    Ctrl+K command palette

    Jump to any advanced feature in one step.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. Clean Architecture

    Domain, application, infrastructure and API layers kept strictly apart.

  2. Audit trail and soft deletes

    Every operation is recorded and nothing financial is ever permanently deleted.
